summary: Implemented hashkey, methodkey, typedkey and typedmethodkey in src/cachetools/keys.py following upstream cachetools 5.x semantics (kwargs folded in with _kwmark, typed variants append argument and kwarg value types); src/cachetools/__init__.py had no stubs left to fill, and its only remaining pass bodies are the upstream no-op cache_clear and except blocks, with no undefined globals. The last full-suite run showed 173 passed and 42 failed, all 42 in tests/test_func.py because cachetools/func.py, owned by the other builder, is still stubbed.
